column1: # Tile pins for the BRouter port's tests (dispatch 2026-10-28-01, Amendment 2, Phase 2 step 1; Phase 1 report, item E4).
# One row per release asset, tab-separated. tools/fetch-tiles.sh reads it; tools/fetch-pinned.sh refuses any file whose
# size or SHA-256 differs. brouter.de rewrites these files in place about daily (Phase 1, item F), so the source URL is
# provenance only: a fresh download from it will not match. The pinned bytes are fetched from a release on Forager-iOS,
# which does not exist yet (the owner's word, RECORD -12).
# Captured 2026-10-29 by one download each (step1-handoff/tiles-downloaded.txt). Each brouter.de tile was loaded in
# BRouter 1.7.10's -ro jar before it was pinned: lookup version 11, the version-checked open, checkFileIntegrity, every
# cell decoded, and one route (docs/audits/2026-10-29-brouter-port-phase2/step1/check-*.log). None was replaced.
# The tiles contain OpenStreetMap data, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, under the ODbL 1.0 (tools/tile-release/README.md).
# Columns: asset, the release asset's name | path, where the fetch puts it under its folder (the engine finds a tile by
# its file name, so F0's fixture keeps W75_N40.rd5 in a folder of its own) | bytes | sha256 | source | last_modified and
# etag, the source's response headers ("-" for a file not fetched over HTTP) | captured, UTC.
